Residual classes are narrower and 2/3 machine-catchable: only-exclusivity (M29 added, fires on the instance), should->oblige strengthening (M28 extended, fires), partial conditional scoping (read-required). Per Matt's option-A regime (detection net + repair pipeline bounding a residual rate), the run CONTINUES and defectives enter the frontier-repair queue; FM23 teaches the only-pair to chunk 4 onward.

3/3 VERIFIED after one softening follow-up (the verifier caught the repair over-correcting 'should only' into must-not+cnpa; fixed to the n022 soft-prohibition precedent and re-verified). Chunk-2 cohort seals at 6/6: 3 faithful as drafted + 3 repaired-and-verified. Known-defect set: EMPTY again.

Fix-loop classes still absent (no derivation-voiding, no sibling imports). Residuals: one prefer-FOR-dispreferred-act inversion in should-not clothing (M28 extended to catch 'should not' vs prefer/permit), one should->must escalation via cnpa (repair per the n022 soft-prohibition precedent), one scope loss (ChatGPT-only commitment generalized) + dropped developer-trust default, one dropped anti-sway claim. All four in frontier repair; run continues per option-A regime.

4/4 VERIFIED after one restructuring round: the verifier surfaced a pre-existing exception defect deeper than the audit's finding (higher-authority mis-relativized to an invented assistant level; permit/forbid unadjudicated) — repaired by relativizing to the misled party (party_level/2 + hierarchy) and guarding the forbids with the negated exception. Chunk-3 cohort seals 6/6: 2 faithful as drafted + 4 repaired-and-verified. Known-defect set: EMPTY.

FM23 HELD (zero exclusivity drops) and zero fix-loop classes; chunk also ran 0 failures / 0 repair-abstentions. All three in frontier repair.
